summary: TRACK 27.10F DAILY REPORT FIELD BEHAVIOR VERIFICATION · VERDICT: PASS. All frontend tests passed. Daily Report V3 page loads correctly on desktop/tablet/mobile. Numeric fields (quantity, percent complete, run hours, idle hours, lunch, subcontractor counts/hours, constraint hours) correctly replace default 0 on first entry. Production/materials/outbound unit dropdowns are searchable and accept standardized construction units (LF, CY, TON, EA, ACRE, SY). Equipment run/idle hours can be entered independently with correct total calculation. No horizontal overflow on any device size. No console errors blocking functionality.

minor.issue: 401 response on employee API call (expected - no auth token in public form)
